analysis: V7 reconciliation of 346-clip validation accuracy evidence (frozen predictions, no inference, no test split)

clip_bootstrap_paired_difference.method: nonparametric clip bootstrap, sorted percentile interval

failures.error: No hand detected in any frame

limitations: Primary unit is the clip; clips are clustered within only 5 validation signers, so intervals do not support signer-population generalization.
One no-hand preprocessing failure counts as incorrect for both models in the primary analysis.
Test split untouched; no held-out test accuracy is reported or implied.
Near-duplicate content across splits cannot be ruled out from manifest/prediction data alone (see split integrity audit).
Per-class N is 2-6 clips; per-class rates are descriptive only.

conditional_paired_difference_95.method: conditional Wilson interval for b/(b+c), linearly transformed to paired accuracy difference

paired.exact_mcnemar_method: Binomial(b+c,0.5), doubled one-sided tail, capped at 1

scope: Official ASL Citizen validation split only (346 vocab-eligible clips, 5 signers). Test split untouched: no predictions, tuning, or model selection on test. Validation accuracy is NOT claimed as official held-out test performance.

signer_level_uncertainty.limitation: With only 5 validation signers, signer-population generalization cannot be estimated; bootstrap quantifies within-sample clip variation conditional on these 5 signers.
signer_level_uncertainty.method: stratified within-signer clip bootstrap (signers fixed, 5 signers); outer signer resampling omitted as uninformative with k=5
